decisions.reason: The copper-coated glass substrate line is still a young flagship option in growing glass-core packaging and high-frequency markets whose uncertainty has not resolved, and it costs little to keep alongside existing glass processing, so it stays open.

VLIS through-glass via structuring was launched in 2024 as a flagship with its own page and complements the copper-coated substrates, so this early, highly uncertain but strategically central option should be kept while its market value is revealed.
